_doc: The MANUAL half of the focus list — names you added by hand. The other half is automatic: any ticker a deep-dive flagged mispriced-long in the last RADAR_AUTO_FOCUS_DAYS (default 180) is unioned in at sweep time from Turso (see listAutoFocusTickers). Focus signals sort first, get their own digest section, and are the only names whose routine earnings releases (Item 2.02) are queued for a deep-dive — other loud signals queue for the whole universe. An empty file is fine: auto-focus still works, and until any verdict lands, all queueing is discovery-driven.
_workflow: You don't need to curate this if you don't know the names — the deep-dive promotes its own longs. Use manual entries for tickers you want earnings-quarter deep-dives on regardless of verdict.
